subject.title: Enhancement: Developer experience quick wins from code analysis

question: Should the remaining work stay as one umbrella, and what operator-visible surface should non-tool skill prompt rewrites use?
rationale: The missing source paths are clear, but status performance boundaries and prompt-rewrite warning UX are product choices rather than a purely mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Split focused follow-ups
options.body: Track status registry diagnostics separately from prompt-rewrite diagnostics, decide the warning surface first, and keep each implementation bounded with targeted tests.

options.title: Keep the umbrella
options.body: Use this issue as the canonical tracker for both remaining quick wins, accepting that the eventual implementation spans status, skills, docs, and tests.

options.title: Narrow to status diagnostics
options.body: Treat the current skills check and docs as enough for skill invocation debugging and keep only the status registry diagnostics request.

recommendation.title: Split focused follow-ups
recommendation.body: Track status registry diagnostics separately from prompt-rewrite diagnostics, decide the warning surface first, and keep each implementation bounded with targeted tests.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already posted the prior keep-open review and is tied by current source history to the affected surfaces.
